title: 54430006-Dead_or_Alive_1_Ultimate.xiso.iso
queue_order: A then B; each request.sh --who rendermode474 --title <this title> --device nova --route survey --seconds 300 --perflog --ref <arm ref> --expect this file
judge: grep 'render_mode:' and 'env: TU_DEBUG' in each logcat; python3 docs/lanes/flip474/sysmemjudge.py (PR #516) over 151-288 s on each arm; the cooling devices and thermal samples of each run; power.j_per_frame from each result.json if power.measured is true
units: GPU, R and X as printed use limits.timestampPeriod; the legs are ratios inside one pair on one device, or gfps.
prediction: #474: with no env and no per-game value, B reads DOA 1 Ultimate's title ID from the disc, finds it in the table and sets TU_DEBUG=sysmem before the Vulkan instance; A does not. B then reproduces flip474's sysmem-by-env arm (X/R 0.02, gfps 21) and A its GMEM arms (X/R 0.98-1.02, gfps 13-16).

legs.M0 (instrument): >= 15 hakuX-phase lines with GPU > 0 in 151-288 s in each arm, and the fight is on screen. Otherwise VOID for that arm, rerun once.
legs.E0 (engaged line): B's logcat has exactly one hakuX-build line 'render_mode: sysmem (table) title=54430006 TU_DEBUG=sysmem'; A has no render_mode line; neither arm has an 'env: TU_DEBUG' line. KILL: B has no such line, or it says auto/default, or a title other than 54430006 (the reader misread the disc). VOID if either arm has an env TU_DEBUG line (the request leaked an env).
legs.D1 (the driver took it): B's X/R median <= 0.25 and A's >= 0.8. Confidence 90%. KILL of 'the default reaches the driver': B's X/R >= 0.8 with E0 holding (the line printed, the driver still binned).
legs.F1 (fps): B's gfps median >= 19 (flip474's sysmem arm read 21) and >= A's + 4. Confidence 70%; the opponent is drawn per run. If D1 holds and F1 fails, report it; it does not refute the mechanism.
legs.T0 (heat): neither arm shows the kernel's cpu3-7 pause (thermal-pause) inside the window in its thermal samples or cooling devices, and the smallest gfps line in the window is >= 0.6 x the median unless the screen shows a scene change. Otherwise VOID that arm (#507), rerun once after a cool-down.
legs.P0 (energy, reported not gated): if both result.json files say power.measured true: report j_per_frame for both. Guess: B <= A (the draw stream runs once, not twice), confidence 55%. A gain in gfps with a loss in J/frame is reported as such.
legs.H0 (no hang): each arm: hakuX-perf lines to the end of the run, no crash marker, and no gap between them longer than 2 x the arm's median gap.

expect_note: EMPTY ON PURPOSE: a soak writes no captures. The legs are read off hakuX-build, hakuX-phase, hakuX-perf and the app's 'env:' lines.
